name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 14 - Am 79
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 14a. Emphasises that the outermost regions of the Union, and in particular the overseas countries and territories (OCTs), require specific support due to their remoteness; draws particular attention to the difficulties in accessing drinking water and sanitation, to the functioning of water infrastructure, and to the need to create new, appropriate infrastructure; notes in particular the poor condition of water distribution networks, which is a common problem in the outermost regions; notes with concern that, although these issues are among the priorities of the Union’s external humanitarian action, the Union’s outermost regions do not appear to be receiving the support they deserve to address these serious problems;
